# Set Theory

A ⊆ B means A is a subset of B.

A ∪ B = {x ∈ U : x ∈ A ∨ x ∈ B}

A ∩ B = {x ∈ U : x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B}

A \ B = {x ∈ U : x ∈ A ∧ x ∉ B}

The power set P(S) = {T : T ⊆ S}.

For any set S, ∅ ⊆ S ⊆ S.

If f : A → B is bijective then |A| = |B|.

The cardinality of ℝ is 2^|ℕ|.

ℕ ⊂ ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ ⊂ ℂ.

∃x ∈ ℝ ∀ε > 0 ∃δ > 0 : |x − a| < δ ⇒ |f(x) − L| < ε.
